![Dungeon Crawler Forever](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/perweum/dungeon-crawler-forever/main/assets/banner.jpg)

# Dungeon Crawler Forever

Dungeon highscores, maps and a journal for **World of Warcraft: Forever**. Open the world map inside a dungeon (or click a dungeon entrance on a
zone map) to see the dungeon's map with its floors and clickable bosses. Uses the game's own map art wherever possible,
so the addon stays small.

Source and issues: https://github.com/perweum/dungeon-crawler-forever

## What it does

- **Highscore.** Every dungeon run is timed from the first fight to the last boss of the dungeon's route, and the **Highscore** tab ranks runs for each level bracket: click a row for the group, the time at every boss, deaths and wipes. Your own best is always shown with its true rank. Finished runs are shared with your group, guild and friends who have the addon (you choose who, or turn it off with `/dm sharing`), so the boards fill up.
- **Journal, maps and routes.** A card for every dungeon and raid, clean floor maps, entrance pins on the world map, and suggested routes for 26 dungeons, and you can draw several routes of your own for any dungeon.
- **Bosses, loot and quests.** Loot with drop chances, abilities, and dungeon quests with your progress.
- **Controller support.** The journal and the dungeon map work with a gamepad (see below).

Status: in active development. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` to help, `data/SOURCES.md` for the data sources and licences.

## Controller support

Works with the game's gamepad UI (Xbox and PlayStation controllers; the button icons follow your controller).

- **Journal:** open it and the D-pad moves between the cards and tabs; **A** opens a card, **B** goes back.
- **Dungeon map:** the **left stick** moves a crosshair, the **right stick** zooms where it points, and pushing the crosshair into the edge of a zoomed map scrolls it. **D-pad Left / Right** switch between the map and the sidebar; in the sidebar **D-pad Up / Down** choose and **A** selects a boss, floor, loot item or quest. **X** hides or shows the sidebar. **B** goes back to where the dungeon was opened from. The game's own **D-pad Down / Up** still switch between the small and the full map.
- **Entrances:** on the world map, put the game's cursor on a dungeon entrance and press **A**.
- A key guide at the bottom shows what each button does right now.
- Controller navigation pauses in combat and while you type.

**Opening it from a controller button.** Type `/dm macros` once. It creates the macros **DM Map**, **DM Journal** and **DM World Map** (`/click DungeonMapOpenMap LeftButton 1` and so on); put them on your controller layout in the game's settings. Use these rather than `/dm` or `/dm list` in your own macros: a typed command opens the map from addon code, and the game then blocks some controller actions (radial menu, chat) after the map closes. `/dm keys` and **Set key** also accept a controller button. The map's own button and radial menu work as usual.

## Licence
Code: GPL-3.0-or-later (see `LICENSE`). Map art credited below is not covered by this licence; it remains the work of its author.

## Credits
- Map art for **The Hall of Thanes** and **Excavation Site: Wetlands**: Santiago Reyes, *Atlas de Azeroth: Forever*
  (low-resolution copies, offered free to the community by the author). https://asguevara433.wixsite.com/srmaps
  The author sells high-resolution versions and accepts donations on his site; please consider supporting his work.
- Dungeon art, boss data and portraits come from the game client and public game-data tables; see `data/SOURCES.md`.
- Boss position data for a few bosses derived from the CMaNGOS classic database (GPL-3.0).

releases.notes:
### Added
- **What's new:** after an update, a small window lists what changed in the new version, once. **Great news** closes it, **Don't show me this again** turns it off for good. Reopen it any time with `/dm whatsnew`, and switch it on or off on the first options page. A new player does not see it for the version they installed.

### Improved
- **Controller focus on popups:** the button you have selected in the welcome, sharing and confirmation windows now has the same gold border as the Journal.
- **Set a key:** the window now sits on top of the welcome window instead of behind it.

### Fixed
- **Tunk:** now lists the Krol'dok Moulding quest item he drops (Horde and Alliance versions).
- **Welcome window with a controller:** "Open the journal" now tells you to set a key for the Journal (or use the minimap button) instead of closing silently.
- **Controller popup navigation:** D-pad chooses a control, the confirm button activates it, and Back closes the welcome, sharing and earlier-runs confirmation windows. Sharing choices require navigation first. Popup actions no longer open a closed world map through the unsafe controller path; use the assigned map/journal key or minimap button.
- **Combat stats:** capture the starting totals before combat and updates after combat ends, when the client makes the meter readable. Earlier-sample fallbacks are labelled incomplete. Pending dungeon verification.
- **First-use sharing question:** retry after the welcome window closes or combat ends instead of skipping the prompt.

### Improved
- **Quest tracker:** now uses the game's damage meter header, background, bar artwork and collapse/expand buttons, with native close and action buttons. More padding, wrapped quest titles and a separate Waypoint/Skip row make it easier to read.
- **Tracker placement:** starts in the center of the screen until you drag it to your preferred position, which is remembered. Collapse it to just the dungeon title and expand it when needed.

### Added
- **Sharing status on the map:** a small dot and a word next to the Journal button on the map: green "Sharing On" when your highscore runs go out, grey "Sharing Off" when you chose Don't share mine, and yellow "Sharing not set" while the sharing question is still open. The same dot is at the bottom of the time in dungeon window. Hover it to see who gets your runs, click it to change. It can be turned off under Map and entrances in the options.

### Fixed
- **The sharing question could be answered by accident:** if you chose to share while you had runs recorded earlier, a box asked whether to share them too, and closing that box with the X counted as "keep them private", which switched your sharing off for good and the question never came back. Closing it now just cancels, and the question stays open until you answer it.

### Added
- **Quest tracker:** a small window that follows a dungeon's quest journey and says what to do next (who to talk to, where), with the next two steps under it. A Waypoint button sets the map waypoint for the step, and Skip step leaves a step out for this character. Turn it on with "Track quests" in the Quests tab (List and Journey views), from the offer after your first quest from a dungeon, or with `/dm tracker`. The next step is marked on the world map with a blue marker, a "?" for a hand-in.
- **Quest markers inside the dungeons:** a blue "!" where an NPC, object or item inside the dungeon hands out a quest, and a yellow "?" where you hand one in. They are now placed in the Forever dungeons too (Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, City of Dalaran, Excavation Site: Wetlands, Alcaz Prison, Shaper's Terrace and more) and in the older ones (Blackrock Depths and Spire, Dire Maul, Uldaman, Stratholme, the Razorfens, Blackfathom Deeps, Sunken Temple, Ragefire Chasm, Scarlet Monastery, Shadowfang Keep). They show only for the quests that are yours: the start until you have the quest, the hand-in while you have it. A new **Hide quests / Show quests** button above Hide route in the map's bottom-left corner hides them (your choice is kept).
- **Quest rewards in the Quests tab:** click a quest and the details show what it asks for and gives, laid out like the game's own quest reward frame: the objective, "choose one of these rewards" and "you will receive" with the item icons and tooltips, experience, reputation and money.
- **Quest items on bosses:** a boss that drops an item a quest needs, an item that starts a quest, or that a quest wants killed gets a blue quest marker on its card and map pin, and the item gets the marker in the loot pane (with the quest's name).
- **More quests:** the Horde quests that open Krol'dok Stronghold, A Small Favor for the Alliance, both Alcaz Prison quest lines to the end (Bad News for Folkar, Thrall Needs to Know, Somber News, Shaw Needs to Know), The Man in the Iron Chains, the Songblade Search chain in Excavation Site: Wetlands, The Treaty of Understanding (started by the item from the vault after Durgen Dirgehammer), Seal of Ascension, Urok Doomhowl, the Horde Paladin chain in the Deadmines and Shadowfang Keep, and more, with their rewards and positions.
- **Damage and healing in the highscore:** each run now records what everybody in the group did, read from the game's own damage meter. The row shows the group's damage and healing per second; open a run to see every member as two small bars (damage and healing) with the total and the per second value. Time is still the only ranking factor. The numbers are shared with the run, so runs from others show them once they are on this version.
- **New instances this hour:** the game refuses you with "You have entered too many instances lately" after 5 new instances in an hour, and never says how many you have used. The sidebar now counts them and shows "3 of 5 new instances this hour"; walking back into an instance you have not reset does not count. At the limit it turns red and says how many minutes until the next slot frees up.
- **Dungeon lockouts:** under the typical clear time the sidebar now says "Locked" with how many bosses are defeated and how long until the lockout resets, or "Not locked".
- **Zul'Farrak: Sergeant Bly** is listed as an optional boss with his loot, including the Divino-matic Rod. You can skip him by running away, and he is not part of the highscore route.
- **Highscore sync fills in boards that look alike:** two players who each held the same number of runs on a board, but different runs, never swapped them. Digests now carry a fingerprint per board, so the difference is noticed and the missing runs are sent. Older versions ignore it.

### Changed
- **Dungeon levels: Available and Recommended.** The sidebar now says "Available: level 16" (the level the game's own Dungeon Finder lets you in at) and "Recommended: level 16-25" (ours). The recommended range starts high enough that you can still hit the last boss (not more than 5 levels below him) and ends before the lowest boss turns grey, so for example Razorfen Kraul is now 28-33 (you could not hit its level 33 boss from 24) and Shadowfang Keep 21-26. The nine new Forever dungeons keep Blizzard's own ranges. Hovering a dungeon on the map or in the journal shows both.

### Changed
- **The time in dungeon window is on by default:** the run clock with the time at each boss now shows for everybody. Turn it off with the X on the window, `/dm timer`, or in the options. (If you had it off, it comes back on once with this update.)
- **Dungeon Set 2 (Tier 0.5) quests:** the long upgrade chain no longer fills every dungeon's quest list. A dungeon lists only the steps that happen inside it (Stratholme: Dead Man's Plea and Proof of Life, with the chain's start; Dire Maul: the three Falrin quests; Blackrock Depths: The Challenge; Blackrock Spire: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate and Three Kings of Flame), and they show only while you have the quest in your log (or have done it).
- **Urok Doomhowl is a summoned boss:** he has to be summoned (kill Highlord Omokk, then place his head on Urok's Tribute Pile, for the Urok Doomhowl quest), so he has the purple ring and is no longer a stop on the Lower Blackrock Spire route. Your times and highscores for that route are kept.

### Fixed
- **Chains you joined later:** a quest in your log now counts as proof that the steps before it are done (for example Scarab Shells in the log makes Tran'rek count as done).
- **Quests for one race only:** a quest that only some races of your faction can take (for example Compendium of the Fallen in Scarlet Monastery, which an Undead cannot) is no longer listed for the others. `/dm questfilter` shows what is hidden in the dungeon you have open.
- **Dungeon quest data:** several quests had a wrong start or hand-in (the Treaty of Understanding, Proof of Life, Songblade Search and others) and the Stratholme list showed the whole Tier 0.5 chain.

### Changed
- **Syncing is one go instead of a few boards at a time:** between players on this version a sync now moves every board (up to 60 boards and 150 runs per request) instead of a handful per 15 minutes. Older versions keep working, at their old pace.

### Added
- **`/dm icons`:** a browser for the game's own icons (search by name, hover for the name, click to copy it).

### Fixed
- **Quests: the Journey tab's line and icons:** the line between steps is continuous with evenly spaced dots, and the List and Journey buttons have icons that follow the button colours.
- **Runs shared with you reach your guildmates:** a run can now be passed on any number of times (it was twice), so the highscores of people who only hear from you fill up. `/dm comms` also says why a request got nothing back.
- **Unreadable shared runs are said out loud:** when someone shares a run your addon cannot read because the route or dungeon data differs, you get one line in chat.
